⌨️ Typing Improvement Tips

Touch Typing
Learn to type without looking at the keyboard. Use all 10 fingers.
Practice Daily
15-30 minutes of focused practice daily yields rapid improvement.
Focus on Accuracy
Accuracy first, then speed. Mistakes slow you down more than careful typing.
Proper Posture
Sit upright, elbows at 90°, wrists neutral. Reduces fatigue and errors.
